title: Cartoon time
text: Wang Bing: What about you, Dad?
Dad: Twenty years ago, I went to shops and paid in cash. Now I often shop online and pay on my smartphone.
Wang Bing: Don't worry, Dad. We have a robot helper.
How did technology change the life of Wang Bing's family?
